symptom: Any client can read/write/delete core collections
root_cause: Rules use allow ... if true for users/videoSessions/notifications/transactions/reviews and others
fix_option: Replace with role- and ownership-based rules; add rule unit tests in Emulator Suite
validation: Run Firebase Emulator rules tests; verify unauthorized reads/writes are denied

symptom: Protected pages can be deep-linked without route-level auth
root_cause: No route uses requireAuth:true and redirect helper setRedirectLocationIfUnset() never sets redirect path
fix_option: Mark protected routes with requireAuth:true and fix setRedirectLocationIfUnset() to call appState.setRedirectLocationIfUnset(location)
validation: Attempt unauthenticated deep links to /videoCallPage and /profile; expect redirect to onboarding

symptom: Potential double-charge/double-earn on concurrent endSession calls
root_cause: Transaction reads student balance but does not re-read/guard session status inside transaction
fix_option: Move session read into transaction and enforce compare-and-set status active/connecting -> ended once with idempotency token
validation: Fire concurrent endSession calls from both participants; verify single billing transaction

symptom: Deepgram API key is hardcoded in mobile client bundle
root_cause: Client-side embedded key can be extracted and abused
fix_option: Issue short-lived server token via callable/proxy; never ship provider API keys in app code
validation: Inspect release apk/ipa strings; key must not be present

symptom: Count query can throw after catchError due null value dereference
root_cause: catchError logs but returns null; then value.count! is accessed
fix_option: Return 0 (or rethrow) from catchError and avoid non-null assertion after failed aggregate query
validation: Inject Firestore error and verify method returns deterministic fallback

symptom: Auth user stream subscription is created but never cancelled
root_cause: listen() result is not retained, causing potential leak and duplicate updates after widget recreation
fix_option: Store StreamSubscription in field and cancel in dispose
validation: Use DevTools memory timeline and verify no orphan auth listeners after hot restarts/navigation

symptom: Artificial startup delay compounds splash wait
root_cause: Hardcoded 3000ms + 1000ms delays block first interactive route
fix_option: Replace fixed delays with readiness-based gating (auth/session init complete)
validation: Measure TTFF and first-interactive before/after on mid-tier Android + iPhone

symptom: Rating histogram is mathematically wrong for 4/3/2/1 stars
root_cause: All bars use where(rating==5) and denominator from currentUserDocument instead of viewed teacher
fix_option: Precompute bucket counts once from reviews and divide by reviewed tutor totalReviews with zero guard
validation: Snapshot test expected histogram values for controlled review fixture

symptom: Division by zero/null risk in rating percentage rendering
root_cause: Percent divides by currentUserDocument!.rating.totalReviews without zero/null guard
fix_option: Use safe denominator max(totalReviews,1) and source from target tutor rating
validation: Render screen with zero reviews and signed-out states; no exception and 0% bars

symptom: Microphone permission may be skipped when camera is already granted
root_cause: Microphone check is nested inside camera-not-granted branch
fix_option: Validate camera and microphone independently before navigation
validation: Test matrix (camera yes/no x mic yes/no); expect permission requests for each missing one

symptom: Rating average update uses stale snapshot and is non-transactional
root_cause: Average is recalculated client-side from old values while totalReviews increment is atomic only
fix_option: Move rating aggregate update to Cloud Function/transaction; write review then recompute atomically
validation: Submit concurrent reviews and verify average/totalReviews stay consistent

symptom: Fallback query can scan entire users collection on tutor query failure
root_cause: On query error function falls back to collection('users').get() and filters in JS
fix_option: Fail fast on query error or use strict indexed fallback query with capped limit
validation: Observe Firestore read count per createVideoSession call under forced query error

symptom: Many nested scrollables and shrinkWrap lists increase layout cost
root_cause: SingleChildScrollView + shrinkWrap ListView patterns trigger expensive relayout
fix_option: Refactor heavy screens to CustomScrollView/Slivers and avoid shrinkWrap for long lists
validation: Profile frame chart while fast-scrolling; compare build/raster frame percentiles

symptom: Post-frame callback scheduled on every snapshot rebuild
root_cause: addPostFrameCallback inside StreamBuilder causes callback churn under frequent snapshots
fix_option: Move navigation side effects to stream listener with distinct state transitions
validation: Enable Firestore debug logs; verify one navigation side-effect per state transition

symptom: Foreground FCM onMessage listener is not tracked for explicit deinit
root_cause: Subscription from FirebaseMessaging.onMessage.listen is not stored/cancelled
fix_option: Store stream subscription and provide dispose/deinitialize path on sign-out
validation: Sign in/out repeatedly and verify no duplicate incoming-call handlers

symptom: Session maps/sets can grow if terminal events are missed
root_cause: Cleanup relies on decline/end/timeout paths; no periodic prune for stale session keys
fix_option: Add TTL-based periodic prune for _sessionCallKitIds/_recentAcceptBySession/_acceptedSessions
validation: Long-running soak with dropped events; memory growth should plateau

symptom: GoRouter diagnostics always enabled in app code
root_cause: debugLogDiagnostics:true creates noisy logs and minor overhead
fix_option: Wrap diagnostics with kDebugMode
validation: Release/profile run should produce no router diagnostic logs

symptom: Analyze baseline has 68 issues concentrated in call summary/video call modules
root_cause: Generated and handwritten files contain many unused imports/nullability issues
fix_option: Fix high-signal warnings first (nullability, non-overriding members, stale imports)
validation: flutter analyze should reach zero errors and reduced warning budget threshold

symptom: Critical realtime/payment/auth flows lack automated tests
root_cause: Coverage improved with auth-routing smoke integration test, but realtime/payment/end-to-end scenarios are still undercovered
fix_option: Add integration tests for login, waiting flow, call join/end, payment/webview and rule tests
validation: CI executes smoke integration suite on Android/iOS simulators

symptom: Large dependency gap raises compatibility/performance risk
root_cause: 84 packages constrained below resolvable versions including core Firebase stack
fix_option: Plan staged upgrades (FlutterFire first, router, media stack) with compatibility matrix
validation: Run full regression after each dependency wave; compare crash-free and FPS

symptom: Large embedded language payload inflates app state initialization footprint
root_cause: Dozens of JSON literals are parsed at runtime into structs
fix_option: Move language catalog to static asset JSON with lazy decode and cache
validation: Measure startup CPU and memory before/after asset-based loading

symptom: Font bundle includes many heavyweight variants
root_cause: 16 OTF variants increase package size and memory pressure
fix_option: Keep only used weights/styles and subset fonts
validation: Compare app size report and memory after font pruning

symptom: Excessive per-tutor logging increases function latency/cost under load
root_cause: Verbose logs inside tutor loop and matching branches
fix_option: Reduce log verbosity to structured summary logs with sampling
validation: Load test createVideoSession; compare p95 latency and log volume

symptom: User files are globally readable
root_cause: read is true for /users/{userId}/** regardless of requester
fix_option: Restrict read to owner or explicitly public assets path
validation: Attempt cross-user file read in emulator; expect deny

symptom: Onboarding crashes in integration smoke due null localization lookup
evidence: integration_test/critical_flows_smoke_test.dart now passes on Android emulator + iOS simulator (2026-03-04); stack trace previously pointed to lib/flutter_flow/internationalization.dart:14 and lib/authorization/onboarding/onboarding_widget.dart:106; USB iPhone run still pending signing/provisioning
root_cause: FFLocalizations.of(context)! assumed non-null localization scope during guarded route transitions in test/runtime edge path
fix_option: Guard localization lookup with null-safe fallback and ensure localization delegates are initialized before onboarding build
validation: Re-run integration_test/critical_flows_smoke_test.dart on Android, iOS simulator, and USB iPhone; expect zero onboarding crashes
